cards.audioText: [Your call sign is QFA378, from Singapore to Wuhan. You are maintaining 10100m estimate fly DAPRO time 45, next ZF at 56, squawk 3625, contact Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是澳航378，从新加坡飞往武汉。10100米保持，预计到达DAPRO时间45分，到达ZF时间56分，应答机3625，联系武汉区调。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA378, ETA DAPRO 45, maintaining 10100m, next ZF 56, squawk 3625.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，澳航378，预计到达DAPRO时间45分，10100米保持，到达ZF时间56分，应答机3625。

cards.audioText: QFA378, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 6300m at own discretion.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，武汉区调，雷达已识别，自主下降保持6300米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 6300m at own discretion., QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 自主下降保持6300米，澳航378。

cards.audioText: [Your weather radar indicates a large groups of CBs southwest of LKO, request turn right heading 050 avoid the weather.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【机上天气雷达显示LKO西南方向有一大片积雨云，请求右转航向050躲避。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA378, request turn right heading 050 due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，澳航378，由于天气原因，请求右转航行050。

cards.audioText: QFA378, Negative heading 050 due restricted area.[Tell Wuhan Control you want to fly heading 030 for at least 5 min before you can resume course.]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，由于限制区，不同意航向050。【告诉武汉区调，恢复航道，你想沿航向030飞至少5分钟。】
cards.referenceText: Request heading 030 for at least 5 min, then turn back to course, QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求沿航向030飞至少5分钟，之后返回航路，澳航378。

cards.audioText: QFA378, turn right heading 030 approved, when clear of weather, turn left direct to LKO.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，同意右转航向030，天气好转后，左转直飞LKO。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Right Heading 030, after clear of weather, direct to LKO, QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向030，天气好转后，直飞LKO，快达378。

cards.audioText: QFA378, descend and maintain 5100m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，下降保持5100米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 5100m, QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持5100米，澳航378。

cards.audioText: [You are maintaining 5100m over LKO, ATIS B is received, now contact Wuhan Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机飞过LKO，5100米保持，收到通播B，现在联系武汉进近。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA378, over LKO, maintaining 5100m, information B.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，澳航378，飞过LKO，5100米保持，通播B。

cards.audioText: QFA378, Wuhan Approach, cleared to LKO-2A arrival, descend and maintain 1200m on QNH1012, information C valid, you are No. 1.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 快达378，武汉进近，可以LKO-2A进场，下降保持修正海压1200米，修正海压1012，通播C有效，你第一个。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: LKO-2A arrival, descend and maintain 1200m on QNH1012, information C, No.1. QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: LKO-2A进近，下降保持修正海压1200米，修正海压1012，通播C有效，你第一个，澳航378。

cards.audioText: [Your weather radar had failed during descent, contact Wuhan Approach to request weather information along your route.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【下降时，机上天气雷达失效，联系武汉进近，请求提供航线途中天气信息。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA378, our weather radar failed. Request weather information along route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，澳航378，机上天气雷达失效，请求提供航线途中天气信息。

cards.audioText: QFA378 our weather radar shows CBs in the vicinity of DA.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，我们的天气雷达显示DA附近有积雨云。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Roger CBs near DA, thank you, QFA378,
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到DA附近有积雨，谢谢，澳航378。

cards.audioText: [There is a crowded cumulonimbus views from the cockpit, describe it to controller and request make a visual maneuver.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【从座舱内可以看到大片积雨云，向管制员描述该情况，并请求目视机动。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA378, there are some CBs surround this area, request visual maneuver.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，澳航378，这一区域附近有积雨云，请求目视绕飞。

cards.audioText: QFA378, negative, military activity restriction.[Tell the controller you need assistance to avoid these weather.]
cards.audioTextZh: 快达378，不同意，军事活动限制。【告诉管制员你需要援助来躲避积雨云。】
cards.referenceText: Request assistance (radar vector) to avoid weather, QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求协助（雷达引导躲）避积雨云，澳航378。

cards.audioText: QFA378, fly heading 030 maintain 1200m.[Read Back]
cards.referenceText: Heading 030 maintaining 1200m. QFA378.

cards.audioText: [After a few minutes, your navigation instrument shows a traffic advisory alert, ask the controller whether he notice the activities.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【几分钟后，机上导航仪表显示交通活动警报，询问管制员是否注意到该活动。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA378, TA traffic alert, do you notice the aircraft around us?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，澳航378，交通活动警报，你是否发现我们周围有活动？

cards.audioText: QFA378, negative show my radar, keep looking.[The aircraft is flying from your left to right at the same level, tell controller what you have seen.]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，我的雷达上未显示，继续观察。【同一高度层中有一架飞机正从你左侧飞到右侧，告诉管制员你看到了什么。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA378, traffic flying from left to right at the same level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，澳航378，同一高度层中有一架飞机从左穿越至右侧。

cards.audioText: Roger, QFA378.[After you have cleared the weather. Request Wuhan Approach for radar assistance to intercept final course of runway 36L.]
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，澳航378。【天气好转后，向武汉进近请求雷达引导切入跑道36左五边航迹。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA378, request radar vectors to intercept final course of runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，澳航378，请求雷达引导切入跑道36左五边航迹。

cards.audioText: QFA378, turn right heading 090, descend and maintain 900m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，右转航向090，下降保持900米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, descend and maintain 900m, QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向090，下降保持900米，澳航378。

cards.audioText: QFA378, turn left heading 300, descend and maintain 600m, cleared to intercept the localizer runway 36L, contact Tower 124.35.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，左转航向300，下降保持600米，可以切入跑道36左航向道，联系塔台124.35。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 300, descend and maintain 600m, cleared to intercept the localizer runway 36L, contact Tower 124.35, QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向300，下降保持600米，可以切入跑道36左航道，联系塔台124.35，澳航378。

cards.audioText: [You encounter downdrafts on short final and executed a missed approach, inform Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在短五边遇到下降气流，执行复飞，通知武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA378, going around due wind shear on short final.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，澳航378，由于五边风切变，复飞了。

cards.audioText: QFA378, when able, turn right heading 090, climb and maintain 1500m, contact Wuhan Approach 119.7.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，可以时，右转航向090，上升保持1500米，联系武汉进近119.7。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, climb and maintain 1500m, 119.7, QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向090，上升保持1500米，联系武汉进近119.7，澳航378。
